data.title: 金色暗影 · 夜灯沙发角的薄纱读夜
data.description: 深夜客厅只亮着一盏落地暖灯，金色暗影赤脚蜷缩在宽大布艺沙发一角，膝上摊着刚借来的地球文学精装书。黑色花卉蕾丝睡裙轻薄地垂落腰际，发梢散开在抱枕间，听见脚步声后她轻轻合拢书页，安静却戒备全消地望过来。
data.location: 暖光落地灯相伴的深夜起居室沙发角落
data.action: 赤脚蜷坐沙发抱膝翻书，抬头静静凝望
data.lighting: 落地灯暖黄侧光穿透薄黑蕾丝边缘
data.camera: 侧前方中景，捕捉静谧柔和的夜读氛围
data.mood: 安静、信任、柔美而微带撩人反差
data.promptProse: Curled barefoot into the corner of a soft living-room sofa beside a warm floor lamp, Golden Darkness rests an open hardcover book across her knees. The sheer black floral-lace negligee drapes delicately over her slight frame as she looks up calmly toward the approaching footsteps.
data.animaCaption: Curled barefoot in the lamplit sofa corner with a hardcover book on her knees, she looks up calmly.
data.nsfwProse: Soft lamplight catches the translucent scalloped edges of her black floral-lace negligee and satin waist ribbon.
